stemMd: Tasks P, Q, R, S and T each take one day, Monday to Friday. P is before R; Q is immediately before S; T is Wednesday; R is Friday. On which day must P occur?
explanationMd: The only available consecutive pair for Q,S is Monday,Tuesday: Wednesday is occupied and Friday is occupied. That leaves Thursday for P, before R on Friday.

distractorRationale.b: Then the adjacent pair Q,S cannot fit around Wednesday.
distractorRationale.e: Then no remaining consecutive pair fits Q,S.
